mitre-cwe.name: Insertion of Sensitive Information Into Debugging Code
mitre-cwe.description: The product inserts sensitive information into debugging code.

notes: When debugging, it may be necessary to report detailed information to the programmer.  However, if the debugging code is not disabled when the product is operating in a production environment, then this sensitive information may be exposed to attackers.

cwe.name: Exposure of Sensitive Information to an Unauthorized Actor
cwe.description: The product exposes sensitive information to an actor that is not explicitly authorized to have access to that information.

mapping_notes.rationale: This CWE entry is at the Base level of abstraction, which is a preferred level of abstraction for mapping to the root causes of vulnerabilities.
mapping_notes.comments: Carefully read both the name and description to ensure that this mapping is an appropriate fit. Do not try to 'force' a mapping to a lower-level Base/Variant simply to comply with this preferred level of abstraction.
